how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for District Court Bongaigaon Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://bongaigaon.dcourts.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 24-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the District Court Bongaigaon recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of applications for the District Court Bongaigaon recruitment is 24th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Peon and Driver posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Peon and Driver posts in the District Court Bongaigaon recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required for the Peon post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Peon post is Class VIII passed. Candidates who have passed HSSLC or above are ineligible for this post.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the Driver post?
faq.answer: For the Driver post, candidates must have passed at least H.S.L.C. and possess a valid LMV Driving License issued by a competent authority.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The age limit for all posts is between 18 years and 45 years as of 1st January 2026. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the Peon and Driver posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the Peon post ranges from Rs. 12,000/- to Rs. 52,000/- per month, while for the Driver post, it ranges from Rs. 14,000/- to Rs. 70,000/- per month, along with grade pay and other allowances.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the District Court Bongaigaon recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will include an Interview/Viva-voce and a Skill Test.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the District Court Bongaigaon recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and the application form can be downloaded from the official website of the District Court Bongaigaon, which is https://bongaigaon.dcourts.gov.in. The direct link is also provided in the Important Links section of this article.
